boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Rice University
boards.description: Ten currently documented, under-21-safe food stops on or reasonably accessible from the Rice–Houston corridor, with late hours verified from venue or local tourism sources.

cards.title: Velvet Taco Rice Village
cards.subtitle: 2525 Rice Blvd, Rice Village
cards.notes: Check the location page before leaving; Friday and Saturday service is listed through midnight, making this a nearby option when campus dining has ended.
cards.short_summary: A Rice Village taco counter with documented midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Velvet Taco lists its Rice Village location at 2525 Rice Blvd and hours until 12 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Current listed hours: Friday–Saturday 10:30 a.m.–12 a.m.; Sunday–Thursday closes at 11 p.m. or earlier. Confirm holiday hours before going.

cards.title: Whataburger — Holcombe & Greenbriar
cards.subtitle: 2265 W Holcombe Blvd, Texas Medical Center edge
cards.notes: Use the location page to confirm service mode; it lists this named Holcombe and Greenbriar location and midnight availability every day.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Whataburger location with daily midnight listed service.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists its Holcombe & Greenbriar location at 2265 W Holcombe Blvd with service shown through 12 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: The official Houston locator lists Holcombe & Greenbriar, 2265 W Holcombe Blvd, with listed hours through 12 a.m. daily; service modes can differ.

cards.title: House of Pies — Kirby
cards.subtitle: 3112 Kirby Dr, Upper Kirby
cards.notes: Plan for a sit-down meal or pickup; the venue’s own location page lists daily hours through midnight and identifies dine-in and takeout service.
cards.short_summary: A Kirby diner and bakery with a documented midnight close.
cards.evidence_claim: House of Pies lists its Kirby location at 3112 Kirby Dr and restaurant hours of 7 a.m.–12 a.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: House of Pies — Kirby Houston location
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours of 7 a.m.–12 a.m. daily; verify any holiday changes before travel.

cards.title: IHOP — Southwest Freeway
cards.subtitle: 2515 Southwest Fwy, Upper Kirby
cards.notes: This is a straightforward all-hours option near the Kirby corridor; the official location page documents dine-in, takeout, curbside, and delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its restaurant at 2515 Southwest Fwy as open 24 hours every day and identifies it as offering late-night food.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 24 hours Monday–Sunday. The page lists dine-in, takeout, curbside pickup, and delivery.

cards.title: OHMYGOGI! Galleria Area
cards.subtitle: 5901 Westheimer Rd, Galleria Area
cards.notes: Check the day-specific schedule before making the trip; the restaurant’s own page documents midnight or later closing every day, with later weekend hours.
cards.short_summary: Korean-Mexican barbecue with documented midnight-to-3 a.m. service.
cards.evidence_claim: OHMYGOGI! lists its Galleria Area restaurant at 5901 Westheimer Rd, with hours through 12 a.m. daily and through 2–3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: OHMYGOGI! Korean Mexican BBQ — locations and hours
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Sunday–Wednesday through 12 a.m.; Thursday through 2 a.m.; Friday–Saturday through 3 a.m.

cards.title: Abu Omar Halal — HTX Downtown
cards.subtitle: 1001 Texas Ave, downtown Houston
cards.notes: Use pickup or dine-in as offered and confirm the day’s schedule. The restaurant’s ordering page lists especially late daily service at its downtown address.
cards.short_summary: A downtown halal-food option listed through 3 a.m. daily and 5 a.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Abu Omar Halal’s direct ordering page lists the HTX Downtown location at 1001 Texas Ave with service until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 5 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Abu Omar Halal — HTX Downtown ordering and hours
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 10 a.m.–3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10 a.m.–5 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Recheck before traveling downtown.

cards.title: BB’s Tex-Orleans Montrose
cards.subtitle: 515 Westheimer Rd, Montrose
cards.notes: Go for the restaurant menu and verify the day’s close. The location page posts late nightly hours and includes a kids menu alongside its food offerings.
cards.short_summary: A Montrose restaurant with hours extending to 3 or 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: BB’s Tex-Orleans lists its Montrose restaurant at 515 Westheimer Rd with hours through 3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 4 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official listed hours: Sunday 10:30 a.m.–3 a.m.; Monday–Wednesday 11 a.m.–3 a.m.; Thursday–Saturday 11 a.m.–4 a.m.

cards.title: Velvet Taco Montrose
cards.subtitle: 907 Westheimer Rd, Montrose
cards.notes: Choose this separate Montrose location when its later schedule fits; the official page distinguishes its hours from the Rice Village restaurant’s schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Montrose taco counter whose Friday and Saturday hours run to 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Velvet Taco lists its Montrose location at 907 Westheimer Rd and Friday–Saturday hours from 10:30 a.m. to 4 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Sunday–Wednesday to 12 a.m., Thursday to 1 a.m., and Friday–Saturday to 4 a.m.

cards.title: Chapultepec Lupita
cards.subtitle: 813 Richmond Ave, Montrose
cards.notes: Confirm the exact day before departing; Houston’s official visitor site lists this named Montrose restaurant’s overnight availability and its Tuesday–Wednesday exception.
cards.short_summary: A Montrose Tex-Mex restaurant documented as open 24 hours most days.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Houston lists Chapultepec Lupita at 813 Richmond Ave as open 24 hours a day except Tuesday and Wednesday, when it closes at 2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Visit Houston states it is open 24 hours daily except Tuesday and Wednesday, when it closes at 2 a.m.; verify directly for changes.

cards.title: Meltwich Rice Village
cards.subtitle: 2518 Rice Blvd, Rice Village
cards.notes: Treat the listed midnight close as a last-call window, not a guarantee. Check the venue’s current ordering or map listing before walking over.
cards.short_summary: A Rice Village melted-sandwich counter listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Maps lists Meltwich at 2518 Rice Blvd, Houston, with hours of 11 a.m.–12 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Apple Maps lists hours of 11 a.m.–12 a.m. Verify the venue’s current hours before going, as map listings may change.
